behavior: Learned standardized ridge combines actual-time price features with original point-in-time news/context features.
Retrospective training uses committed mapping visibility and each member original/observed availability; exact real H1 outcomes must mature by cutoff.
Current news requires guardedv165source proof, exact source bindings and actual consumer observation; no prior forecast performance is invented.
Matched price-only fit uses identical rows; neutral-news ablation uses the same joint coefficients, not an arbitrary news-to-pips weight or causal impact claim.
Shared immutable gzip capture is bounded and canonical-hash addressed; pair captures retain compact replayable features and own price bytes.
limits: Retrospective overlapping training rows are not independent news events.
63tests establish implementation behavior, not predictive improvement.
Actual-history compression reduces duplicate storage but does not impose a retention policy.
